exact_char0.dimension_argument: Two independent codimension-2 affine linear sections of Sing_S are 0-dimensional and nonempty over Q. For a pure-dimensional closed set V in affine space, a generic codim-2 linear section is 0-dimensional iff dim V = 2, empty if dim V <= 1, and positive-dimensional if dim V >= 3. Two independent nonempty 0-dim sections of comparable modular degree certify dim Sing_S = 2.
